description:
Sends the shipping-label email again to the buyer of a create_checkout_link session: the message SMKlog sent when the label was bought, with the link that opens and prints the label, the tracking number and the order status page. Use it when the human says the label email never arrived or was lost. It goes only to the email address the buyer typed at checkout; the agent cannot choose or see that address and gets no label file or link back. It creates, changes and voids nothing; get_checkout_status is where the tracking number is read.

Parameter rules:
- session_id is the as_ plus UUID id from create_checkout_link.
- Works from label_ready on. Earlier it answers label_not_ready, after a refund label_refunded.
- At most 3 emails per order in 24 hours, then label_email_limit.
- dry_run true checks everything and sends nothing.
- An unknown or expired id answers session_not_found.
- 60 calls an hour per client, shared with get_checkout_status.

dry_run.description: True checks that the email could be sent and sends nothing.

name: resend_label_email

outputSchema.description: Whether the label email went out again.

order_id.description: SMKlog order id of the label

remaining_today.description: Emails still allowed for this order in the current 24 hours

sent.description: True when the email was sent by this call

title: Send the label email again
